capabilities: record audio inside Obsidian with selectable input devices
transcribe recordings via OpenAI Whisper or Google Gemini with automatic size chunking
clean up transcripts using Anthropic, OpenAI, or Gemini with custom formatting instructions
create Markdown notes from date/time templates or paste output at the cursor
save the audio file and note even when transcription or post-processing fails
extras: Per the README, direct recording is supported on macOS and iOS only; API keys are required for transcription and post-processing, though failed runs still save the audio and note.
problem: Obsidian can record audio but cannot transcribe or summarize it, so users must handle recordings in external tools.

relations.evidence: transcribe them using OpenAI Whisper or Google Gemini with automatic size-chunking
Google Gemini: Transcribes using the latest stable Gemini API (e.g., gemini-2.5-flash)
Automatically cleans up transcripts using Anthropic (Claude), OpenAI (GPT), or Google (Gemini)

summary: Audio recorder that transcribes recordings with OpenAI Whisper or Google Gemini and summarizes them with an LLM of your choice.
